historical_references.reference: Navalkant Bhagavatula was a renowned mathematician, professor and Indian independence activist from Andhra Pradesh, India. He was the founder of the Indian Mathematical Society in 1931 and served as its first president. He was also a member of the Indian National Congress, and was arrested for his activism during the Quit India Movement in 1942.
